page.overview:
What is Crystal Tower?

The Crystal Tower is a dungeon located at the Nonary Region of Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is first visited in Chapter 19, "The Other Nine Wood Hills" and is the starting location of Chapter 20, "The Crimson Prophecy's End".

;First Floor Contains a Gate. There are two Warp Crystals to the right of the Gate that transport the player to the upper floors: the blue one leads to the third, while the red one leads to the seventh. The entrance of the tower leads back out to the Nonary Region.

Four Gimme Golems are found on the descending stairway leading to an amber Warp Crystal that provides access to the Secret Respite.

In the Maxima version, after clearing the Postscript, a purple portal appears that leads to a new location where the player can fight The Immortal Dark Dragon.
